verdict.text: The reviewer concluded that the iPhone 17 Pro Max has a completely new design, improved build quality, and a smooth display. The audience is positive about the product, with 41% of comments being positive and 56% neutral.

audience_words.text: The audience is discussing the design, camera, battery, performance, price, and where to buy the iPhone 17 Pro Max.

agreement_words.text: The reviewer and the audience agree that the iPhone 17 Pro Max has a completely new design, but disagree on the weight of the phone.
